content: Research indicates that contract mining scenarios often carry a cost premium of 15% to 50% over owner-mining, a margin that mining houses are increasingly looking to reduce through digital efficiency and automated tracking [cite: 34, 35]. SEO and Digital Visibility Gaps The South African industrial sector suffers from a "weak digital system" paradox: while companies are operationally strong, their digital footprints are often static or non-existent [cite: 16]. LoRaWAN and Personnel/Asset Tracking Low-power, long-range wireless protocols like LoRaWAN are being deployed for tracking personnel badges and mobile assets (e.g., excavators, drills) without the need for high-cost, fixed fiber infrastructure everywhere on site [cite: 30].
